hooks.command: : flocker-repo-tmpdir; f="${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}"; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; c=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$c" in */.git) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; r="${c%/.git}"; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; w=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); g="$r/tmp"; if [ -n "$w" ] && [ "$w" != "$r" ]; then g="$g:$w/tmp"; fi; mkdir -p "$r/tmp" && printf 'export TMPDIR="%s" TMP="%s" TEMP="%s" GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES="%s${GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES:+:$GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES}"\n' "$r/tmp" "$r/tmp" "$r/tmp" "$g" >> "$f"; exit 0
